title: Ad-hoc collab tally + priority matrix — May 2034
body:
Ad-hoc collab tally and priority matrix — quick tracker for lightweight cross-functional asks (working sheet)

Columns: Item | Requestor | Priority | Est Effort (hrs) | Suggested Owner | Dependency (team/tickets) | SLA/Deadline | Status | Notes | Estimated $ Impact

1) Billing spikes follow-up | Maya R. | P0 | 12 | Leila G. | billing-service / JIRA-6818 | 2034-05-18 | in_progress | Needs quick sampling of 6 customers; possible quota tweak | $1,440
2) Demo dataset refresh | SalesOps | P1 | 8 | Samir R. | data-team / GH-PR-2076 | 2034-05-22 | blocked | Waiting on cleaned csv; sales needs updated examples | $960
3) Quick SLO runbook patch | Platform SRE | P0 | 6 | Connor O. | runbooks repo / JIRA-6799 | 2034-05-16 | review | Small edits + add rollback steps | $720
4) Console tour copy edits | Marketing | P2 | 4 | Mei L. | marketing-assets | 2034-05-30 | todo | Copy review only; low effort | $480
5) Short quant pilot checklist | Applied ML | P1 | 10 | Jordan P. | quant-pilot / JIRA-6820 | 2034-05-25 | in_progress | Need GPU time estimate and quick eval set | $1,200
6) Partner SLA exception note | Legal | P1 | 3 | Leila G. | legal-review | 2034-05-20 | todo | Draft required for partner A | $360
7) One-off capacity carve request | SolutionsEng | P0 | 9 | Samir R. | capacity-claims / JIRA-6836 | 2034-05-19 | in_progress | Hot request for pilot customer; may need burst GPUs | $1,080
8) Embed cost sanity check | Observability | P1 | 5 | Mei L. | metrics-dash / GH-issue-412 | 2034-05-23 | review | Check aggregation window; potential double-counting | $600
9) Rapid integration checklist | Professional Services | P2 | 2 | Connor O. | ps-templates | 2034-05-29 | todo | One-page checklist for enablement calls | $240
10) Mini-privacy audit for pilot | Security | P0 | 3 | Jordan P. | security-audit / JIRA-6842 | 2034-05-21 | in_progress | Scoped to data flows for pilot only | $360

Quick totals & heuristics:
- Total estimated effort (hrs): 62
- Headcount effort split (rough): Eng/Product: 44h; SRE/Infra: 6h; Docs/Marketing/Legal: 12h
- Total estimated engineering cost (assume $120/hr blended): $7,440

Immediate asks / recommended next steps:
- Confirm burst GPU capacity for item 7 by EOD 2034-05-15 (owner: Samir). If unavailable, propose degraded timeline to partner.
- Leila to draft partner SLA exception note and loop legal; target 2034-05-18 for first pass.
- Connor to land SLO runbook patch review and merge; small risk window 2034-05-16.
- Samir/Applied ML to share cleaned demo dataset link (GH/drive) — currently the single blocker for item 2.

Notes to self (working):
- This sheet is intentionally lightweight — use as handoff/litmus for short-lived cross-team asks. Delete rows once ticketed or merged into product backlog.
- Consider adding a small "burn" checkbox column for weekend coverage if any P0s move into off-hours window.
- Reconcile cost impact against monthly ops budget week-of 2034-05-20.

Open questions / unresolved:
- For partner SLA exception (item 6) what is the legal threshold for revenue at which we require full SOC review? @Leila to confirm.
- If quota tweak (item 1) is applied, how quickly can clients be rolled back in case of regressions? Need SRE input.

Change log (brief):
- 2034-05-10: created by Jordan Patel — initial capture of asks
- 2034-05-12: added effort estimates and cost heuristics; Samir added notes for capacity request
- 2034-05-15: Leila added partner SLA item; Connor noted runbook review in progress

Bottom-line: Use this as the single quick surface for ad-hoc cross-functional asks this sprint. Prefer ticketing (JIRA/GH) per row within 48h of assignment to ensure traceability.
